nodes.label: Deploy to Vercel workflow
nodes.rationale: Vercel's Git integration is disconnected because the Hobby plan only deploys the account owner's commits; this workflow deploys every push to main with the owner's token so any collaborator's commit goes live. Concurrency group vercel-production (cancel-in-progress false) keeps one production deploy at a time so a newer push waits rather than racing.

nodes.label: Pre-deploy build and check gate
nodes.rationale: A commit that breaks the site never reaches production: npm ci, npm run build and npm run check run before any Vercel step.

nodes.label: Commit authorship rule (Codex)
nodes.rationale: Commits and PRs belong to the git identity that made them; never add Codex co-author trailers or AI attribution.

nodes.label: Commit authorship rule (Claude)
nodes.rationale: Commits and PRs belong to the git identity that made them; never change author/committer and never add Co-Authored-By Claude trailers or 'Generated with Claude Code' lines.

nodes.label: Cabinet Grotesk (Infinity Kitchens cover only)
nodes.rationale: Limited to the Infinity Kitchens cover so it matches that brand's own visual identity.

nodes.label: Kinetic ZEL vector wordmark hero
nodes.rationale: Oversized ivory ZEL lettering on cobalt with damped pointer stretching and an ivory/cobalt switch on activation; replaces the earlier sculpture while keeping the established frame dimensions and surrounding typography.

nodes.label: Featured project layout (Fogstores lead, two-column row)
nodes.rationale: Fogstores is the full-width lead with original fashion photography; Infinity Kitchens and BNM Cafe form the next two-column row; all stack on mobile; detail views show real images and link to live websites.
nodes.norm_label: featured project layout (fogstores lead, two-column row)

nodes.label: ZEL agency (brand register)
nodes.rationale: Presents ZEL as an agency building unique digital solutions for businesses and people with ambitious ideas: distinctive websites, commerce platforms and custom operational tools.

nodes.label: Design principles (preserve reference scale, credit reference media)
nodes.rationale: Preserve the reference viewport scale, generous margins, black type, pale background, 3D, sound and scroll rhythm; build real interactive effects; credit reference media and never present it as ZEL client work.
nodes.norm_label: design principles (preserve reference scale, credit reference media)

nodes.label: Accessibility and inclusion requirements
nodes.rationale: Keyboard-operable navigation and dialogs, visible focus, sound off until enabled, reduced-motion support, mobile adaptation.

nodes.label: In-place client router (src/main.js, src/page.js)
nodes.rationale: Header, sound and dialogs persist while page content is fetched and swapped under the page transition; back/forward use the same path; any failure falls back to normal navigation. Static per-route HTML means every URL also works on a plain static host.

nodes.label: Hero wordmark pointer stretch and colour switch
nodes.rationale: Rendering stops once settled, offscreen or in a hidden tab; reduced motion keeps the wordmark static but retains the colour switch.
nodes.norm_label: hero wordmark pointer stretch and colour switch

nodes.label: Pointer trail (coalesced + predicted events, 1-euro smoothing)
nodes.rationale: Filter cutoff rises with speed so slow movement loses mouse quantisation jitter while fast movement keeps the tip within a few pixels; no input buffer; getPredictedEvents draws a capped step ahead to offset one frame of display latency and is withdrawn when input stops; over media the trail retracts rather than vanishing.

nodes.label: Preloader (filling bar, odometer, Z mark fold)
nodes.rationale: Tracks only what the first screen needs (the page and the Aeonik font, not below-the-fold media), then lifts into the hero intro.
nodes.norm_label: preloader (filling bar, odometer, z mark fold)

nodes.label: Page transition (Lusion TransitionOverlay model)
nodes.rationale: One top-layer canvas drawn with plain fills and a cut-out; the page is never filtered or scaled so it holds full frame rate; the swap happens while the screen is covered and a failsafe always releases the curtain.

nodes.label: Line-by-line text reveals (GSAP SplitText)
nodes.rationale: SplitText autoSplit so lines re-wrap on resize; reveals are split only when within a screen of view.

nodes.label: ScrambleText project tags
nodes.rationale: Tags decode from scrambled characters with a static copy kept for screen readers.

nodes.label: Ambient audio and UI sounds (Ogg + AAC, on demand)
nodes.rationale: Sounds download the first time sound is switched on; AAC is served where Ogg cannot play (Safari before iOS 18.4).
nodes.norm_label: ambient audio and ui sounds (ogg + aac, on demand)

nodes.label: Dialog scroll lock, keyboard dismissal and focus restoration
nodes.norm_label: dialog scroll lock, keyboard dismissal and focus restoration

nodes.label: Inner-scrolling dialogs with close button in view
nodes.rationale: Long dialogs (the brief on short screens, case studies) scroll inside so their close button stays in view.
nodes.norm_label: inner-scrolling dialogs with close button in view

nodes.label: On-demand loading strategy
nodes.rationale: First screen waits only for HTML, two stylesheets, script and preloaded Aeonik font; posters a screen before video; Data Saver or 2G keeps the reel on its poster; WebP at displayed size; reel muxed with +faststart.

nodes.label: Project case study view and screenshot lightbox
nodes.rationale: Customer names, courier tracking numbers and the owner's email are blurred; captures showing customer contact details are left out.
nodes.norm_label: project case study view and screenshot lightbox

nodes.label: Three-step project brief (mailto or download)
nodes.rationale: Nothing is submitted to a server: the brief is emailed to support@zel.agency through the visitor's mail app or downloaded, so a visitor without a mail app can only download it.

nodes.label: ZEL homepage reel (16:9 and 4:5 HyperFrames cuts)
nodes.rationale: Frame 0 is the closing lockup and also the poster so idle poster and loop point match; the 4:5 cut is chosen when the frame is closer to 4:5 than 16:9 (videoSource in src/page.js).
nodes.norm_label: zel homepage reel (16:9 and 4:5 hyperframes cuts)

nodes.label: Live dandelion canvas (src/bloom.js)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the former flower loop; built only when it comes within a screen of view.

nodes.label: Device testing matrix (26 viewports, WebKit + Chrome)
nodes.rationale: Not covered: Firefox, real-device GPUs, perceptual audio; scroll smoothness under throttling still to be re-measured.
nodes.norm_label: device testing matrix (26 viewports, webkit + chrome)

nodes.label: Light-only colour scheme
nodes.rationale: Declared light-only so forced dark modes (Samsung Internet, Chrome auto dark) leave the colours alone.

nodes.label: Lusion reference media and Aeonik font licensing
nodes.rationale: Ambient audio and UI sounds remain Lusion reference media; reference media and font retain original ownership and need licences or replacements for a public launch. README states the page no longer carries a credits section.
nodes.norm_label: lusion reference media and aeonik font licensing

nodes.label: Brief form partial (brief-form.html)
nodes.rationale: The brief form appears twice (contact dialog and contact page), so it is written once and included through {{brief-form}}.

nodes.label: Custom scroll indicator (.scroll-indicator)
nodes.rationale: Native page and dialog scrollbars are hidden while this custom page indicator remains.

nodes.label: Open Graph and Twitter meta placeholders
nodes.norm_label: open graph and twitter meta placeholders

nodes.label: Pledge signature and ink stamp SVG
nodes.norm_label: pledge signature and ink stamp svg

nodes.label: Immutable caching for app.js, style.css, projects.css
nodes.rationale: Safe because these URLs carry a content hash that changes with their content.
nodes.norm_label: immutable caching for app.js, style.css, projects.css

nodes.label: commit-msg AI attribution stripper
nodes.rationale: Backstop: deletes Co-Authored-By lines naming Claude, Anthropic, Codex or OpenAI and 'Generated with Claude Code/Codex' lines.

nodes.label: site URL constant (zel-tau.vercel.app)
nodes.rationale: Link previews (og:image, og:url) need absolute URLs.

nodes.label: contact config (support@zel.agency, @agency.zel)
nodes.rationale: One source for how to reach ZEL: the footer, menu, contact page and search listing all read it.

nodes.label: hashOf() content hash
nodes.rationale: Normalises CRLF to LF before hashing so a Windows checkout and CI agree on the version.

nodes.label: Page render loop (placeholder fill, aria-current, versioned URLs)
nodes.norm_label: page render loop (placeholder fill, aria-current, versioned urls)

nodes.label: JSDOM harness running dist/app.js on dist/index.html
nodes.rationale: Stubs canvas (chaining Proxy), dialogs, media, observers and matchMedia (reduced motion unless --motion) so the bundled app runs headless.
nodes.norm_label: jsdom harness running dist/app.js on dist/index.html

nodes.label: Menu/contact/media dialog and root scroll-lock assertions
nodes.norm_label: menu/contact/media dialog and root scroll-lock assertions

nodes.label: Project, case study and lightbox assertions
nodes.rationale: Case-study images only appear when a project opens, so project data is checked directly for image existence.
nodes.norm_label: project, case study and lightbox assertions

nodes.label: Asset path, sound file and colour-scheme checks
nodes.norm_label: asset path, sound file and colour-scheme checks

nodes.label: fastHeadLag() tip-lag test
nodes.rationale: The tip must stay on the cursor at speed: no fixed filter lag or input buffer.

nodes.label: Frame-independent tilt damping test
nodes.rationale: Tilt damping must give the same result regardless of frame duration.

nodes.label: Dev static server (port 5173)
nodes.rationale: Unknown paths return 404 with dist/index.html as the body.

nodes.label: Lenis smooth scroll (startSmoothScroll)
nodes.rationale: Smooth scroll is deliberately slow (duration 1.05, quartic ease) to give the visual sequence room; skipped under reduced motion and driven from the GSAP ticker so ScrollTrigger stays in sync. ScrollTrigger ignores mobile resizes because browser bars resizing the viewport would make pins jump.

nodes.label: audio controller
nodes.rationale: Sound starts off, so nothing is downloaded until it is first switched on. Safari before iOS 18.4 cannot play Ogg Vorbis, so it gets AAC (.m4a) copies. Players are created lazily and cloned per hover/click.

nodes.label: audio.toggle()
nodes.rationale: The button answers at once; music can take seconds to start on a slow connection and is only rolled back if play fails. The attempt counter stops a rejection from an earlier tap undoing a later one.

nodes.label: Input mode tracking (html data-input-mode)
nodes.rationale: Dialog focus restoration should not add a keyboard ring after a pointer click: pointerdown sets pointer mode, an unmodified keydown sets keyboard mode.

nodes.label: navigate() client-side router
nodes.rationale: Pages are swapped in place (header, sound and dialogs persist) under the page transition; the next page is fetched in parallel with the cover animation. Any failure falls back to a normal navigation.

nodes.label: Delegated same-origin link router
nodes.rationale: Same-page anchors scroll smoothly and close the menu first; known routes go through navigate(); modified clicks, external, targeted and download links are left to the browser.

nodes.label: Delegated contact trigger listener
nodes.rationale: Contact triggers live in pages, the footer and the menu, so one delegated listener covers them and survives page swaps.

nodes.label: Brief step navigation handler
nodes.rationale: Project brief forms ask three short steps: what, when, then who. Taps come first and contact details last, so starting costs nothing; steps 1 and 2 require a selection.

nodes.label: Brief submit handler (mailto + download)
nodes.rationale: No backend: the brief is composed as plain text and offered as a mailto link to support@zel.agency and a downloadable Blob; the previous object URL per form is revoked via a WeakMap.

nodes.label: renderProject() case study
nodes.rationale: The case study leads with every screenshot, customer side first, on a 12-column grid whose rows always fill (each shot's span comes from projects.js).

nodes.label: openFrom() dialog grow-from-origin
nodes.rationale: Dialogs open out of whatever was clicked: clipped to its rectangle in the site blue, the dialog grows to full size while settling to its own surface and its contents rise in behind. data-opening is kept until close, because removing it while open would re-enable the CSS entrance and replay it.

nodes.label: openReel()
nodes.rationale: The reel just plays with no player chrome and picks a 4:5 cut on portrait screens. Without controls a blocked play cannot be started, so it falls back to muted and, as a last resort, shows controls.

nodes.label: showShot()
nodes.rationale: Captures taller than they are wide scroll at full width instead of shrinking (except phone/photo shots); neighbours are pre-warmed so stepping feels instant.

nodes.label: Lightbox swipe gesture
nodes.rationale: A horizontal swipe steps; vertical drags stay scrolls; a tap beside the image closes.

nodes.label: Pointer paint input handler
nodes.rationale: Captures every coalesced input sample plus the browser's prediction for the next one, so the trail is drawn in the same frame the input arrives. Mouse and wide screens only; over media the trail stops taking input and retracts instead of vanishing.

nodes.label: sizePaint()
nodes.rationale: The canvas backing store is only allocated once a mouse moves, so touch screens never pay for it; DPR capped at 1.25.

nodes.label: trailBands colour stack
nodes.rationale: Each colour band is the original 18% layer stack composited over white. Drawing bands opaque lets overlapping segments merge seamlessly; on the multiply-blended canvas white is invisible, so mixing toward white fades a band along the trail.

nodes.label: drawPaint() pointer trail renderer
nodes.rationale: Age drives both width and colour (tip strongest, tail thins and fades); quadratic segments through midpoints, consecutive segments in the same colour step share one stroke.

nodes.label: First-load boot sequence
nodes.rationale: Preloader, then the page intro. The page starts at the top (manual scroll restoration) so the intro is what is seen.

nodes.label: mountPage()
nodes.rationale: Everything owned by one page is built when it mounts and fully torn down before the next one (AbortController signal, cleanup list, gsap.matchMedia revert).

nodes.label: videoSource()
nodes.rationale: Videos with a portrait cut (data-src-portrait) use it when their frame is closer to 4:5 than to 16:9.

nodes.label: liteData()
nodes.rationale: With Data Saver on or on a 2G connection, decorative loops stay on their posters (the reel still plays when opened).

nodes.label: Ambient video lazy loader
nodes.rationale: Loads only the video loops approaching the screen and pauses them out of view or under reduced motion.

nodes.label: Poster prefetch observer
nodes.rationale: Posters are fetched a screen ahead of the videos, so they never compete with the first paint.

nodes.label: Decorative CSS loop sync (syncLoops)
nodes.rationale: Marquees and chart chips share the video loops' visibility lifecycle: animation-play-state is paused offscreen, when the tab is hidden, or under reduced motion.

nodes.label: Scroll-scrubbed page scenes
nodes.rationale: Hero heading parallax, ribbon path drawing, flower frames, reel frame scale, and the laptop turning through the section while its lid opens on the hinge.

nodes.label: Reel pin ScrollTrigger
nodes.rationale: Created after the triggers below it, so refreshPriority 1 makes it refresh first or their starts would ignore the pin spacing. Desktop only (min-width 813px).

nodes.label: Reel cursor follower and magnetic pills ticker
nodes.rationale: Both share one frame-damped GSAP ticker; geometry is read before any transform writes (avoiding layout thrash) and compensates for existing transforms.
nodes.norm_label: reel cursor follower and magnetic pills ticker

nodes.label: Page handle (prepareIntro / playIntro / unmount)
nodes.rationale: The page intro runs inside its own gsap.context so leaving the page reverts it too.

nodes.label: initBloom()
nodes.rationale: The frame is below the fold on every screen, so the scene is only built once it is a screen away.

nodes.label: buildBloom() dandelion scene
nodes.rationale: A dandelion drawn live in the about frame in the ink-on-cobalt treatment the footage had; it turns slowly, lets seeds go on the breeze and regrows them so the head never goes bald. Safari returns no context once its canvas memory budget is spent, so the frame keeps its tinted background. Reduced motion gets one still frame.

nodes.label: seedHead() Fibonacci lattice
nodes.rationale: Seeds sit evenly over a sphere on a Fibonacci (golden-angle) lattice; the underside stays bare where the stem joins.

nodes.label: resize() (bloom)
nodes.rationale: Uses layout size, not the on-screen box: the frame tilts in as it scrolls, and a rotated box would stretch the scene.

nodes.label: drawHead()
nodes.rationale: Near, middle and far seeds are stroked as three Path2D batches, fading and thinning with depth.

nodes.label: step() (bloom simulation)
nodes.rationale: The breeze lets a seed go every second or so from the near side of the head; now and then an out-of-focus seed drifts across the foreground for depth.

nodes.label: settle()
nodes.rationale: Seeds the scene with a few seconds of breeze so it never opens on a still head; seed positions are only projected just before a release step.

nodes.label: Pointer blow interaction
nodes.rationale: A pointer moving fast through the head blows seeds loose along its path; a press scatters a handful.

nodes.label: initConfetti()
nodes.rationale: Contact hero field: dots, rings, crosses and capsules drift around their homes, leave the headline clear, and part around the pointer. Static when reduced motion is preferred.

nodes.label: build() (confetti)
nodes.rationale: Keeps an ellipse around the headline clear; shape count scales with area, capped at 260.

nodes.label: initHero() kinetic wordmark
nodes.rationale: A responsive, vector-only wordmark: no shaders, textures or 3D scene. A click toggles data-inverted / aria-pressed.

nodes.label: targets() letter weights
nodes.rationale: Gaussian weighting around the pointer widens the nearest letter; widths are normalised to a fixed total.

nodes.label: playPreloader()
nodes.rationale: A progress bar and odometer track what the first screen needs (the web font is awaited), with a 700ms minimum so it reads as intentional and a 3s cap. It deliberately does not wait for window load: posters, sound and below-the-fold images load on demand.

nodes.label: tick() (preloader progress)
nodes.rationale: Eases toward 100 but holds short of it until the page has actually loaded.

nodes.label: finish() preloader exit
nodes.rationale: The bar folds into the Z mark and the curtain lifts; onReveal fires 1.1s into the timeline.

nodes.label: damp()
nodes.rationale: Exponential smoothing preserves its response across display refresh rates.

nodes.label: initNextPage()
nodes.rationale: Footer next-page band: its bar fills as the band scrolls into view; once the page bottom is reached, continuing to scroll fills the accent bar and moves to the next page. Touch screens have no wheel, so only a finger dragging up counts, not a fling's momentum.

nodes.label: pullBy()
nodes.rationale: distance is how far past the bottom it takes to fill the bar (700 for wheel, 300 for touch); resets after 800ms idle and is ignored while scroll is locked.

nodes.label: fillPill()
nodes.rationale: Direction-aware fluid fill: a blue disc grows from where the pointer enters a pill; re-entering mid-drain flows from where it is.

nodes.label: drainPill()
nodes.rationale: Carries the disc's centre to the exit point as it shrinks, so it drains out of that edge; a pinned pill (sound on) stays filled.

nodes.label: initPills()
nodes.rationale: Mouse hover on fine pointers fills pills; keyboard focus gets the same treatment, from the centre.

nodes.label: initSoundWave()
nodes.rationale: Sound icon: a travelling wave while sound is on, easing flat when it is off.

nodes.label: PointerTrail
nodes.rationale: 1-euro filter: the cutoff rises with speed, so slow movement loses quantisation jitter while fast movement keeps almost no lag.

nodes.label: PointerTrail.push()
nodes.rationale: The newest point always follows the filter and is committed once it has moved far enough (spacing); history capped at 1024 points.

nodes.label: PointerTrail.frame()
nodes.rationale: Retracts the tail continuously rather than dropping whole points; once input pauses the residual filter lag closes so the tip rests exactly on the cursor; draws ahead by the browser prediction to offset one frame of display latency, fading quickly once input stops.

nodes.label: shot() screenshot factory
nodes.rationale: -thumb is the cropped grid tile, the plain file is the full image the gallery opens; size is the tile's footprint on the 12-column grid (phone 2, photo 3, wide 6, full 12).

nodes.label: riseLines()
nodes.rationale: Lines rise out of masks; SplitText autoSplit re-splits on resize/font load and replays the tween in place, so wrapping always matches the current layout.

nodes.label: set() empty-safe gsap.set
nodes.rationale: Skips empty lists so pages without a hero or scroll cue do not trigger GSAP warnings.

nodes.label: prepareIntro()
nodes.rationale: Hidden until the curtain lifts, so nothing flashes in its final position first.

nodes.label: initReveals()
nodes.rationale: Splitting text measures layout, so each text reveal is built only once its element is within a screen of view; a page pays for what is read, not all of it at load. Reveals are added to the page's matchMedia context so leaving the page reverts them.

nodes.label: Ledger count-up
nodes.rationale: Figures count up once; the markup keeps the final value for no-JS and reduced motion.

nodes.label: Project card tilt and tag scramble
nodes.rationale: Cards tilt back in perspective and settle flat; tags decode from scrambled characters while assistive tech reads a static copy, and an invisible ghost copy holds the final height so the changing wrap never moves the page.
nodes.norm_label: project card tilt and tag scramble

nodes.label: initRoute() dotted trail
nodes.rationale: A dotted trail threads the waypoints in DOM order and draws itself as the page scrolls; each waypoint lights up as the trail reaches it. Reduced motion shows it complete.

nodes.label: centre()
nodes.rationale: Offsets ignore transforms, so the cards' entrance animations cannot bend the trail.

nodes.label: layout() (route)
nodes.rationale: Leaves and arrives vertically so it swings across between sides; stacked waypoints (phones) bow out alternately instead.

nodes.label: createPageTransition()
nodes.rationale: Everything is drawn on one canvas in the top layer (popover) with plain fills and a cut-out; the page underneath is never filtered or scaled. Shapes are drawn in units of n px.

nodes.label: measure()
nodes.rationale: The full-screen backing store is released between transitions and reallocated here; DPR capped at 1.5.

nodes.label: finish() (transition)
nodes.rationale: Never leave the curtain up: on any drawing error or pagehide, release everything waiting on it.

nodes.label: cover()
nodes.rationale: The page is seen through a huge window that spins and shrinks into a white bar, which prints a dot-matrix LOADING; resolves once fully covered. Window easing starts faster than expo so it responds the moment it is clicked.

nodes.label: reveal()
nodes.rationale: Holds LOADING for a beat if the page arrived instantly so the sequence reads; the dots sweep away, the bar turns into the Z's diagonal, then the Z becomes the window and grows until the new page fills the screen.

nodes.label: run()
nodes.rationale: For in-page views (case studies): cover, act while covered, reveal.

nodes.label: raise()
nodes.rationale: Re-enters the top layer so the curtain stays above a dialog opened while covered.

nodes.label: data-reel hook
nodes.rationale: Dual use: page.js treats [data-reel] elements as reel triggers, while main.js sets data-reel on the media dialog as a state flag while the reel plays.

nodes.label: Defer work until needed (low-end budget)
nodes.rationale: Cross-cutting principle: build scenes, split text, fetch posters/videos/sound and allocate canvases only when they are near the viewport or first used, so slow phones pay for what is seen.

nodes.label: Pause animation offscreen or when tab hidden
nodes.rationale: Animation loops are gated by IntersectionObserver visibility and document.hidden so nothing runs that cannot be seen.
nodes.norm_label: pause animation offscreen or when tab hidden

nodes.label: Reduced-motion fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Every animated module has a prefers-reduced-motion path that shows the finished or still state instead of motion.
